sl_ventilation_zones.title: SL ventilation pilot rooms
sl_ventilation_zones.description: Review the three proposed zones before they are created: Nanils (`sensor.sz_climatecontrol_room_temperature` / `sensor.sz_climatecontrol_room_humidity`), Nino (`sensor.nino_climatecontrol_room_temperature` / `sensor.nino_climatecontrol_room_humidity`), and Küche (`sensor.kuche_climatecontrol_room_temperature` / `sensor.kuche_climatecontrol_room_humidity`). No rooms are created if you turn this off.

data.create_sl_ventilation_zones: Create these three explicitly reviewed pilot zones

sl_surfaces.title: SL facades and roofs
sl_surfaces.description: Review the six plan-derived, unshaded reference planes before they are created: North 80.39 m² / 90° / −175° (no vendor GTI is available yet), East 69.38 m² / 90° / −95°, South 80.39 m² / 90° / −5°, West 69.38 m² / 90° / +85°, East roof 61 m² / 15° / −95°, West roof 94 m² / 17° / +85°. Window and other-opening areas are stored separately. These values describe incident radiation only; they do not claim a heating or cooling load.

data.create_sl_surfaces: Create these six explicitly reviewed surface subentries
